Package com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.beta.sensors

Class NearestItemSensor

java.lang.Object
com.noorlandmc.NoorEntities.ai.beta.sensors.NearestItemSensor
All Implemented Interfaces:
MannequinSensor
public class NearestItemSensor extends Object implements MannequinSensor
Sensor — scans for the nearest Item entity (a dropped item stack) within a configurable radius and writes its UUID to the mannequin's PersistentDataContainer.

This sensor is intentionally simple: it tracks one item at a time (the closest) and exposes it under NEAREST_ITEM_PDC_KEY. Goals that want to move toward or pick up dropped items should read that key.

PDC contract:

  • Key present → the UUID string of the nearest item entity is stored.
  • Key absent → no item is within range (or the item was removed).

Reading the key from a goal: 


 PersistentDataContainer pdc = mannequin.getPersistentDataContainer();
 if (pdc.has(NearestItemSensor.NEAREST_ITEM_PDC_KEY)) {
     UUID itemUUID = UUID.fromString(
         pdc.get(NearestItemSensor.NEAREST_ITEM_PDC_KEY, PersistentDataType.STRING));
     // Resolve the entity — it may have been picked up since the last sense tick
     mannequin.getWorld().getEntities().stream()
         .filter(e -> e.getUniqueId().equals(itemUUID) && e instanceof Item)
         .findFirst()
         .ifPresent(e -> { /* move toward e *&#47; });
 }

Registration example: 


 brain.getSensorSelector().addSensor(mannequin,
     new NearestItemSensor(myPlugin, 8.0, 3)); // scan radius 8, every 3 ticks

Priority suggestion: register with an intervalTicks() of 2–5 to amortize the cost of entity scanning across multiple brain ticks.

    • intervalTicks

      public int intervalTicks()
      Description copied from interface: MannequinSensor
      How many brain ticks to wait between calls to MannequinSensor.sense(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin).

      A value of 1 means sense every brain tick. A value of 5 means sense every fifth brain tick. Stagger different sensors across different intervals to spread the CPU cost of world-scanning.

      Defaults to 1 (every brain tick).

      Specified by:
      intervalTicks in interface MannequinSensor
      Returns:
      interval in brain ticks (≥ 1)

    • sense

      public void sense(org.bukkit.entity.Mannequin mannequin)
      Scans for the nearest in-range Item entity.
      • If one is found, its UUID is written to NEAREST_ITEM_PDC_KEY.
      • If nothing is found, the key is removed so goals see a clean "nothing nearby" state.
      Specified by:
      sense in interface MannequinSensor
      Parameters:
      mannequin - the mannequin this sensor is attached to
